prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right choice depends on your exact location in Phoenix, your unit’s brand/age, whether you need emergency repair or a replacement, budget, and any warranty requirements. I can, however, give a short list of reputable paths to take and a few commonly recommended providers, plus a quick checklist to compare quotes.

Reputable options to consider
- Goettl Air Conditioning & Plumbing — a long-established Arizona company with broad service coverage in the Phoenix area, offers repairs, replacements, and maintenance plans.  
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (local Phoenix branch) — national service company with 24/7 emergency repair capability and multi‑trade service (HVAC, plumbing).  
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning (Phoenix franchise) — national franchise known for quick response/service‑time guarantees and routine maintenance programs.  
- Brand-authorized local dealers (Carrier, Trane, Lennox, Mitsubishi, etc.) — if you want a replacement under OEM warranty or factory-authorized installs, look for a local authorized dealer for your brand.

What I recommend you verify for any company
- Valid Arizona license (Registrar of Contractors) and proof of insurance.  
- Technician certifications and EPA 608 certification for refrigerant work.  
- Clear written estimate (parts, labor, diagnostic/service fees) and a warranty on repairs/parts.  
- Up‑front pricing or a clear diagnostic fee and estimate before work begins.  
- Recent customer reviews (Google, Yelp, BBB) and examples of similar jobs.  
- Availability for emergency/after‑hours service if you need it.

Next step I can do for you
- If you tell me your Phoenix ZIP code or neighborhood and whether this is an emergency repair or a planned replacement, I’ll pull 3–5 highly rated, nearby HVAC companies (with phone numbers, recent review summary, and any specialties) so you can call for quotes. Which ZIP or neighborhood are you in, and how urgent is the work?
